question: Which epidemiological week will be the onset week for the flu in HHS Region 7 in 2026-27?

calls.reasoning: Region 7 weighted ILI (Delphi mirror of ILINet, issue 202645) was 1.10, 1.22, 1.48 for wks 43-45 vs a 2.0% regional baseline; growth is speeding up (10%->21%/wk), lab positivity in Region 7 is rising (CDC wk45), and all four states are trending up. The H1N1 subclade E wave is moving east from the West Coast. Week 46 needs ~35% growth to reach 2.0 (about 15%). Thanksgiving falls in week 47 and adds a holiday bump on top of real growth, so week 47 is the modal onset. The risk is a post-holiday dip in week 48 if week 47 only just crosses, which would push onset to 48-49. In 2024-25 and 2025-26 the region crossed in week 50 with slower growth. No prediction market found.
calls.reference_class: Recent HHS Region 7 ILINet seasons (2022-23, 2024-25, 2025-26): weeks from ~1.5% wILI to sustained >=2.0% crossing, adjusted for the Thanksgiving-week holiday bump

calls.reasoning: Region 7 wILI weeks 40-45: 1.08,1.04,1.11,1.10,1.22,1.48 vs baseline 2.0%; week 45 rose ~21% WoW amid a national H1N1 wave (national 3.8%, 7 of 10 regions above baseline) with Region 7 positivity rising. Closest analog 2023-24 (1.64 at wk45 -> 1.92, 2.21 on Thanksgiving week 47, 2.26, 2.39) implies onset wk47. Thanksgiving falls in week 47 in 2026 and historically adds ~15-20% to ILI%, and levels held afterward in 2023-25. Week 46 onset needs a ~35% jump (the max seen in other regions this season), so it is unlikely. Slower growth (neighbor Region 5 ~12%/wk) or a post-holiday dip would push onset to wk48-49. No human market found (Polymarket/Kalshi only list national hospitalization contracts).
calls.reference_class: Region 7 ILINet seasons with wILI ~1.3-1.7% at week 45 and a rising trend (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26, 2018-19), plus Thanksgiving-week ILI behavior

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Region 7 typically reaches its ~2.0% ILI baseline in December (2025-26 onset was wk50), so ≥50 is the unconditional favorite. But 2026-27 is an early H1N1 season: 7 of 10 regions incl. neighbors 6 and 8 are above baseline, national ILI 3.8%, and Region 7 weighted ILI rose 1.10→1.22→1.48 (wk43-45) with all four states' flu ED share increasing. At 10-30%/wk growth wk46 ~1.6-1.9 (crossing unlikely); Thanksgiving falls in wk47, which typically inflates ILI%, so wk47 likely ~2.1-2.3 and the modal onset. Risks: a post-holiday dip in wk48 breaking the 3-week rule, or growth stalling as in wk40-44, push mass to 48-49+. No human market found (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi).
calls.reference_class: HHS Region 7 ILINet onset weeks (3 consecutive weeks >= regional baseline ~2.0%) in recent seasons, conditioned on wILI ~1.5% at week 45 in early-season years
